verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Sentry has an official CLI. A CLI can in principle be scripted headlessly, but the pack gives no detail on CI usage, non-interactive authentication, or which automation tasks it supports. The SDK and self-hosting evidence covers other capabilities and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. release or sourcemap upload steps in pipelines), non-interactive auth via tokens or env vars, scope of CLI commands, and hands-on corroboration of headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
